about: Greece's 2026 restrictions for trucks over 3.5 t on the motorway and national road sections the joint ministerial decision lists (Κεφάλαια Α1 and Α2: leaving and entering the cities) on its holiday dates (Β1-Β8) and summer weekends (Β9-Β11), transcribed from the ΦΕΚ; tools/tables/check_bans.py checks the dates and hours against it. Each holds only on its section and direction, so a trip is said to may run into it.
